description: GDI ClearType's x geometry of a glyph is NOT reproduced by FreeType: no variant measured equals it (interpreter v35 / v40, hinting off, x hinted at 6 x ppem, the natural outline centred in or scaled to the compatible advance, the unhinted x with the hinted y; log/roadmap/S5/3_fit.py, 3_fit2.py, 3_phase.py, 3_fity.py, 3_mix.py). Measured: with the best per-glyph offset some glyphs still differ in shape (Arial Bold 10 'H' 18 levels, Manual SSi Bold 15 '0' 58 levels: stem widths and edge phases), and on Manual SSi Bold 15 about 20 of 94 glyphs ('$', '%', '0', 'A', 'S', 'd', 's', ',', ':' ...) sit about 5-6 samples (one pixel) right of the best placement rule (3_mix_corr_51b360.log, res column) with no FreeType-visible property that separates them. This is the cause of the remaining label difference (3_notes.md section 6: 70 % of the corpus ink pixels differ, 95 % of those by 4 or more 5-bit steps in some channel).
path to resolution: Reproducing the Windows TrueType rasterizer's ClearType mode (its x-direction instruction handling and placement in compatible-width mode) would be needed; a disassembly of win32kfull / the font driver, or published rasterizer documentation, would settle it.

description: The raster's placement rule and its selector are FITTED on the three faces the corpus draws: head flags bit 4 set (Arial, hinted advances) -> centred by (6 x compatible advance - 6 x linear advance) / 2 samples (Arial Bold 10: 2,722 differing levels against 3,637 at the pen, 3_fity_center.log / 3_fity_none.log); linear advances with an hdmx table (Manual SSi) -> shifted by 6 x the x displacement v35 hinting gives the leftmost point (Manual SSi Bold 15: 5,668 against 7,987 at the pen, 3_mix_rules_v40.log); linear advances without hdmx (Klepto ITC TT) -> origin at the pen (3,350 against 6,562 centred, 8,814 with the displacement, 3_mix_rules_v40.log). Whether hdmx presence is what GDI keys on, and how other faces behave, is not established.
path to resolution: Measure more faces (a host face with linear advances and hdmx, one with bit 4 set and no hdmx) with log/roadmap/S5/3_mix.py --rules and 3_fity.py.

description: y smoothing: GDI's levels on Manual SSi and Klepto ITC TT (no gasp table) show fractional horizontal edges (Manual SSi Bold 15 'H' crossbar 5 / 1 over two rows, 3_gdi_levels.py), Arial Bold 10 (gasp range <= 17 ppem flags 0x5) none. The raster scans 6 subrows when the face has no gasp table or its gasp range for the ppem has GASP_SYMMETRIC_SMOOTHING (bit 3), level = round half up (count / 6). The subrow count 6 is fitted (4 to 16 give totals within 1 %, 3_fity.py), and Arial at 18 ppem (flags 0xf) could not show whether bit 3 switches smoothing on, because its hinting puts every horizontal edge on a pixel boundary.
path to resolution: A face with a gasp table whose range sets bit 3 and whose hinting leaves fractional y edges; a font with gasp flags 0x2 only.

description: The raster's blend uses contrast 1200 and RGB subpixel order, the values SystemParametersInfoW reports on LIVING-PC (labels.py facts); the port does not query the host (deterministic output). A Windows host with another ClearType tuning draws GDI labels differently from both the port and this host; the blend model itself is equal to GDI on every grey 5-bit pair at 1200 (test_fttext_raster.py test_blend_equals_gdi) and other contrasts change 660-1,125 of its 7,168 entries (3_blend_contrast.log).
path to resolution: Decide whether the port's FreeType provider follows the host's ClearType settings (Options::contrast / bgr exist) or keeps the recorded host's.

description: What GDI's TextOutA draws for the five code page 1252 bytes MultiByteToWideChar leaves undefined (0x81 0x8d 0x8f 0x90 0x9d) and for C0 control bytes was not measured: the corpus leaves out texts with C0 bytes (S5.2) and holds none of the five. The raster draws nothing for the five and the cmap's glyph (0 = .notdef) for any other byte.
path to resolution: Draw each of them with GDI on a 32-bit DIB (3_gdi.py) and compare.

description: GDI's synthetic emboldening of the raster (a bold request on a face lighter than 600, S5.1's +1 advance) is not modelled: draw_glyphs draws the regular outline at the +1 advances. No FontRef of the game requests it (S5.1, 1_notes.md section 2). Synthetic italic is not needed either: the only style-2 FontRef (g_font51b340, Comic Sans MS Bold italic) resolves to ariali.ttf, a real italic face (S5.1), and draws no recorded text (S5.2).
path to resolution: Probe GDI's emboldened ClearType raster if a FontRef ever needs it.

description: The raster's gamma tables are computed with the C runtime's pow (round(255 (i/255)^g), round half up). x64 and Win32 builds give the same corpus digest (5a336eba..., test_fttext_raster.py); another C library's pow could round an entry differently where 255 (i/255)^g lies within one ulp of a half integer.
path to resolution: Pin the two 256-entry tables in a test (computed values, not GDI bytes) when the port is built with another toolchain.
